newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends week up on ringgit-aided buying.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends week up on ringgit-aided buying.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Oct (3rd pos) 1,169 rgt/tonne July (south) not available
Open/Hi/Low 1,147/1,170/1,146 Prev close 1,195*
Prev settlement 1,153 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Ended higher on strong speculative and consumer buying due to the continuous weakening of the ringgit. Near-term based on the currency factor. July 1-20 export data on Monday expected to have little impact on the market. New trading range seen at 1,140-1,180.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Active and followed futures trend.
"Next week's performance is almost entirely dependent on whether the ringgit is going to fall any further," he added.
Traders said a weaker ringgit made exports of Malaysian palm oil cheaper and more competitive.
The ringgit hit a 38-month low of 2.6310 against the dollar on Friday due to dollar short-covering by corporate players and speculative selling of the currency.
Traders said July 1-20 palm oil export data to be released by cargo surveyor SGS (M) Sdn Bhd on Monday was not expected to have much impact on the market.
"There is a concern that stocks (of palm oil) is building up because of the lack of exports, but I think for next week, the ringgit factor will override this," said one trader.
Another added: "There will be enough consumer interest to see a rally next week if the ringgit stays weak."
Traders said players were also not unduly bothered about weather conditions in the U.S. Midwest and its effect on soy crops, which was a factor earlier this week.
At the close, the new third-month October futures was up 16 ringgit to 1,169 ringgit ($444.30) a tonne.
Closing prices of physicals were not available on Friday.
At midday, physicals July (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,197.50 ringgit a tonne against bids at 1,195. The contract was traded at 1,195.
July (central) saw offers at 1,185 ringgit against bids at 1,180.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,197.50 ringgit against bids at 1,195. The contract saw trades at 1,190 and 1,195.
Aug (central) was offered at 1,185 against bids at 1,180.
In refined palm oil, Aug/Sep RBD palm oil was offered at $487.50. Oct/Nov/Dec RBD palm oil was also offered at $487.50.
Aug RBD palm olein saw offers at $527.50, Sep at $525 and Oct/Nov/Dec at 522.50. Aug was traded at $525.
Aug RBD palm stearin was offered at $372.50 and Sep at $370.
Aug/Sep RBD palm fatty acid distillate saw offers at $290.
-- K. Baranee Krishnaan (603-275-6834) ($1=2.5970 ringgit)
